mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS pid, p.name AS pname, p.workshop AS workshop, p.duration AS duration, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT e.name ORDER BY e.name) AS equipment, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT q.name ORDER BY q.name) AS risks, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d.name ORDER BY d.name) AS defects FROM product_process pp JOIN process_node p ON pp.process_id = p.id LEFT JOIN process_equipment pe ON p.id = pe.process_id LEFT JOIN equipment e ON pe.equipment_id = e.id LEFT JOIN process_risk pr ON p.id = pr.process_id LEFT JOIN quality_risk q ON pr.risk_id = q.id LEFT JOIN risk_defect rd ON q.id = rd.risk_id LEFT JOIN defect d ON rd.defect_id = d.id WHERE pp.product_id = #{productId} GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.workshop, p.duration ORDER BY p.id

SELECT gp.id AS product_id, gp.name AS product_name, p.id AS pid, p.name AS pname, p.workshop AS workshop, p.duration AS duration, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT e.name ORDER BY e.name) AS equipment, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT q.name ORDER BY q.name) AS risks, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT d.name ORDER BY d.name) AS defects FROM graph_product gp JOIN product_process pp ON gp.id = pp.product_id JOIN process_node p ON pp.process_id = p.id LEFT JOIN process_equipment pe ON p.id = pe.process_id LEFT JOIN equipment e ON pe.equipment_id = e.id LEFT JOIN process_risk pr ON p.id = pr.process_id LEFT JOIN quality_risk q ON pr.risk_id = q.id LEFT JOIN risk_defect rd ON q.id = rd.risk_id LEFT JOIN defect d ON rd.defect_id = d.id WHERE gp.category = 'benchmark' GROUP BY gp.id, gp.name, p.id, p.name, p.workshop, p.duration ORDER BY gp.id, p.id
